title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the drawing-sheet world. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Drawing Sheet
options.thesis: Every screen is a drawing sheet: readiness is a dimensioned instrument reading, never an opinion.
options.viewport: One drawing sheet: title block carrying the stencil verdict, the role model dimensioned in orthographic view, redline callouts on critical gaps, parts list down the left edge.
options.risk: A print language can read as a static PDF; the measure tool and live redlines must make the sheet feel like an instrument.

raised.raise: Session progress rides one ruled vertical scale; every observation is pinned to its phase.
The legend never moves: a stable title block stays readable while everything else orients to it.
Progress draws every competency at fixed scale on one baseline — registered, overlayable, never re-scaled.
One raking light: the active region takes the light; everything else falls into its own shadow.
Ghost cells: unachieved evidence is drawn as deliberately as achieved — absence is a visible ghost, never a void.
One strict grid rules every sheet; captions and labels live on the same ruling, and the grid adapts while letterforms stay true.

options.label: The Flight Deck
options.lineage: aircraft instrumentation & the primary flight display
options.thesis: The dashboard is a primary flight display: readiness is the central instrument, competencies run as an altitude tape, every session opens with a checklist.
options.viewport: Primary flight display: central readiness readout, right-hand competency tape with the target role line, alert flags on critical gaps, pre-flight checklist card low.
options.risk: The incumbent's close cousin — dark panel plus one accent; checklist choreography and lamp grammar must make it Pramya, not a themed dashboard.

options.label: The Painted Plate
options.thesis: The product as a painted industrial plate: flat planes, one raking light, and the readiness verdict as one stenciled numeral.
options.viewport: The verdict as a large stenciled numeral over stacked competency plates; the active plate takes the light, the rest fall into hard shadow.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: competency groups as overlapping planes, light as focus; loses narrowly on audience — industry art sits one step from the engineer's own drawings.
options.risk: Grain-elevator abstraction can read cold or artful; the stencil verdict must stay unmistakably a measurement.

options.label: The Segment Mask
options.thesis: Fixed-slot instrument readouts where unlit segments are drawn as ghosts: absence is as deliberate as light.
options.viewport: The readiness verdict as a fixed readout; every unachieved segment glows faintly; an unset profile blinks like an unset clock.
options.case: Fuses strongly on Pramya's absence-of-evidence principle; the eight-cell mask constrains 14 surfaces too hard to own the whole world.
options.risk: Reads as retro novelty unless the grid stays absolute.

options.label: The Deep Dive
options.thesis: Preparation as descent: a vertical depth axis ruling every line, evidence pinned to its exact depth and phase.
options.viewport: A ruled vertical axis descends through preparation phases; each observation sits at its depth.
options.case: Fuses poorly: engineers do not identify with cave diving, and depth/thermocline maps weakly onto competency evidence.
options.kept: One ruled vertical axis; observations pinned to phase.

options.label: The Rain Garden
options.thesis: A garden where colored rain falls according to cloud rules and nothing stays still.
options.viewport: Colored rain bends around objects; the legend alone stays level.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a surreal rain world cannot carry deterministic measurement or serious stakes.
options.kept: A stable legend; state shown as motion.

options.label: The Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Five fixed-scale plates on one baseline, each stage drawn at the same exact scale and ground.
options.viewport: Readiness across sessions as registered plates on one shared baseline.
options.case: Fuses weakly: the species-plate metaphor does not carry readiness, though fixed-scale comparison is a genuine raise.

options.label: The Phosphor Render
options.thesis: One strict monospace grid as the entire composition; glyph density stands in for light and value.
options.viewport: The verdict rendered as glyph density on a fixed character grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: glyph-density-as-value obscures exact measurement and lands in the banned developer-tool register.
options.kept: One strict grid; captions on the same ruling.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What every interview-prep SaaS ships: clean grid, white cards, one accent — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, card wall, blue primary button — the expected arrangement at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
